sources.title: Jointly Predicting Courses and Grades Using a Transformer-Based Model
sources.snippet: Existing predictive models in learning analytics often treat student academic history as a simple sequence, overlooking the concurrent nature of courses taken within a semester. This simplification can lead to inaccurate performance predictions, particularly for students with heavy or challenging course loads.
